name: AI Recipe: Alternate History
description: Claude writes an eight-section "what if" timeline from one real historical divergence, with a portrait cover and one rendered 16:9 scene per section when an image key is set. Optional premise queue via alt-history-ideas.md.

parameters.label: ai-automation-recipes clone
parameters.help: Absolute path to your local clone of ai-automation-tools/ai-automation-recipes.

parameters.label: Output folder
parameters.help: Root folder for all recipe output. Each recipe writes into its own collection under it.

parameters.label: Claude model
parameters.help: Claude model alias for the run.

parameters.label: Cover image engine
parameters.help: auto uses the first of GEMINI_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY that is set (add it as a task secret or in the clone's .env). none skips the cover and the eight scene images; the piece still publishes as text.

author: ai-automation-tools
